articles.title: Bayern extends Eberl and Dreesen contracts through 2029
articles.description: Bayern Munich has extended the contracts of board member for sport Max Eberl and chief executive Jan-Christian Dreesen through June 2029. The club announced the extensions after a supervisory board meeting on Tuesday. Eberl faced challenges after taking over Bayern’s transfer dealings in February 2024, including a difficult search for a new coach. He eventually appointed Vincent Kompany, who led Bayern to back-to-back Bundesliga titles. Dreesen became CEO in May 2023 after Oliver Kahn's dismissal.

articles.title: Jump strikes out 9 and Cortes homers to lift A's over Twins 4-2
articles.description: Carlos Cortes homered and Gage Jump struck out nine in 6 1/3 innings as the Athletics beat the Minnesota Twins 4-2. Jump pitched into the seventh for the first time since June 18 against the Angels, when he allowed one hit in seven innings. Cortes launched a two-run homer in the second. Tommy White hit an RBI double in the sixth and Donovan Walton added a run-scoring single, extending the lead to 4-0. Minnesota starter Taj Bradley tied his career high with 11 strikeouts, but gave up four runs and seven hits in 6 2/3 innings. He struck out the side on nine pitches in the fifth for the first immaculate inning in Twins history.
